clause: Local tonal/detail retouch brushes: dodge, burn, sponge, blur, sharpen, median, smudge [STU-RAS-027]

scope.summary: Implement the local-effect brushes as brush-engine tools: Dodge (lighten) and Burn (darken) with tonal-range targeting (shadows/midtones/highlights), exposure, and protect-tones; Sponge (saturate/desaturate) with vibrance protection; and the local-effect brushes Blur (soften), Sharpen (edge contrast with protect-detail), Median (edge-preserving noise reduction), and Smudge (smear pixels in the drag direction, with finger-painting).
acceptance_criteria: Blur/sharpen/median/smudge local brushes proven on snapshot
expected_tests: live: dodge lightens with shadows/midtones/highlights targeting + protect-tones; sponge desaturates with vibrance protection
live: blur softens, sharpen increases edge contrast (protect-detail), smudge smears in the drag direction
acceptance_criteria_original: blur/sharpen/median/smudge local brushes proven on snapshot

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-027]** Studio MUST provide the local tonal and detail retouch brushes as brush-engine tools: Dodge (lighten) and Burn (darken) with tonal-range targeting, exposure and protect-tones; Sponge (saturate/desaturate) with vibrance protection; and the local-effect brushes Blur (soften), Sharpen (edge contrast with protect-detail), Median (edge-preserving noise reduction), and Smudge (smear pixels in the drag direction, with finger painting). A tone brush that applies a non-destructive tonal shape by painting, and an undo brush that paints an earlier history state back in, are members of this same family and MUST be driven by the one brush engine.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
